name: calme
description: Read and update your own Calme meal, exercise, weight and water records from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Calme (カロミー) is a Japanese calorie and meal tracking app. This plugin lets Calme users work with their own records from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Ask about your day: calories, protein, fat and carbs eaten, meals by time slot, exercise, water and weight.
- Look back over weeks: daily nutrition trends compared with your goals, and weight and body fat trends.
- Log meals by just telling ChatGPT what you ate. Each food is first matched against Calme's food data (official nutrition labels from chains and the Japanese Standard Tables of Food Composition). Only foods with no match are saved as ChatGPT estimates, and the app shows them as estimates.
- Fix or remove meals you logged, change the amount, move a meal to another day or time slot, or copy a past meal (for example, "the same breakfast as yesterday").
- Log exercise, weight and water, and delete weight and water entries.

Who it is for: people who already use the Calme iOS app in Japan. You sign in with the same Apple ID you use in the app.

Limitations:
- Japanese only. Dates are in Japan time.
- You need a Calme account created in the iOS app.
- Records can be added, changed or deleted only for the last 30 days.
- Calme gives general calorie and nutrition information. It does not give medical advice, diagnoses or medication guidance.
capabilities: Read your daily calories, PFC, meals, exercise, water and weight
Show nutrition and body trends against your goals
Log meals using Calme's food data, with ChatGPT estimates only as a fallback
Change, copy or delete meals you logged in the last 30 days
Log exercise, weight and water, and delete weight and water entries
defaultPrompt: 今日あと何kcal食べられる？
昨日の食事のPFCバランスを教えて
お昼にサラダチキンとおにぎりを食べたので記録して

positive.description: Reads one day of the user's own records. The demo account has sample meals on this date. (Prompt: 'Tell me the PFC balance of my meals on November 1.')
positive.prompt: 11月1日の食事のPFCバランスを教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_daily_summary for 2026-11-01 (Japan time) and answers in Japanese with total calories and protein/fat/carbs for breakfast, lunch and dinner from the demo account. No medical advice.

positive.description: Compares a week's intake with the user's goal. (Prompt: 'How did my average calorie intake from October 20 to 26 compare with my goal?')
positive.prompt: 10月20日から26日の平均摂取カロリーは目標と比べてどうだった？
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_nutrition_trend for 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-26 and get_goals, then reports the daily average and the difference from the calorie target. Days without records are not treated as zero intake.

positive.description: Shows weight change over a period. (Prompt: 'How much did my weight change from October 20 to November 1?')
positive.prompt: 10月20日から11月1日で体重はどれくらい変わった？
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_body_trend for 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-01 and reports the first and last weights and the change in kg (the demo data goes down by about 1 kg).

positive.description: Logs a meal using Calme's food data. (Prompt: 'I had salad chicken and a rice ball for lunch, please log it.')
positive.prompt: お昼にサラダチキンとおにぎりを食べたので記録して
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_foods for each food, then log_meal once for today's lunch with the matched food_id values. Replies with each item's calories, the meal total and today's total. The meal appears in the Calme app.

positive.description: Logs exercise with an estimated calorie burn. (Prompt: 'I jogged for 30 minutes, please log it.')
positive.prompt: 30分ジョギングしたので記録して
positive.expected_behavior: Calls log_exercise with activity_name, duration_minutes 30 and a MET value for jogging. Calme calculates the calories with the same formula as the app ((MET - 1) x 3.5 x weight / 200 x minutes) using the latest weight, and ChatGPT reports the calories burned.

negative.description: General nutrition question that is not about the user's own records. It should be answered without Calme tools and nothing should be logged. (Prompt: 'How many calories are in salad chicken?')
negative.prompt: サラダチキンのカロリーを教えて

negative.description: Asks for another person's records. Calme only accesses the signed-in user's own data, so no tool should be called. (Prompt: 'Show me what my friend ate today.')
negative.prompt: 友達の今日の食事を見せて

negative.description: Medical dosing question. Calme does not give medical advice, so no tool should be called and the user should be pointed to a doctor or pharmacist. (Prompt: 'How much diabetes medication should I take?')
negative.prompt: 糖尿病の薬はどれくらい飲めばいい？

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read your Calme records, and log, change, copy and delete meals, exercise, weight and water.

ja-JP.subtitle: 食事・体重の記録と振り返り
ja-JP.description:
カロミーの記録を、ChatGPTから見たり記録したりできます。

できること
・今日や昨日の摂取カロリー・PFC、食事区分ごとの品目、運動・水分・体重を聞く
・数週間の栄養の推移を目標と比べる、体重・体脂肪率の推移を見る
・食べたものを伝えるだけで食事を記録する。品目ごとにカロミーの食品データ（各社公式の栄養成分表示と日本食品標準成分表）から探し、見つからない品目だけChatGPTの推定値で記録します（アプリでも推定値と分かる表示になります）
・記録した食事の量・日付・食事区分を直す、消す、「昨日と同じ朝ごはん」のように写す
・運動・体重・水分を記録する、体重・水分の記録を消す

使える人：iOSアプリのカロミーを使っている方。アプリと同じApple IDでサインインします。

ご注意
・日本語のみ。日付は日本時間です
・追加・変更・削除できるのは過去30日の記録です
・カロリーや栄養の一般的な情報をお伝えするもので、診断や薬についての助言はしません
